methodWhy: The pinned interpretation is decided by a declared invariant and a declared multiplicity in OMG's normative machine-readable Kernel Semantic Library -- TPCGuardConstraint's inv { allTrue(constrainedGuard()) } connected from transitionLink: HappensBefore[0..1] to guard. No sentence stands between the artifact and the claim. The SysML prose Description says the same thing and corroborates; it is not what the claim rests on.

normativeDocument.title: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML), Version 2.0, Part 1: Language Specification

clause: SysML v2.0, 8.3.18.9 TransitionUsage; grounded in KerML 1.0 Kernel Semantic Library 9.2.10 Transition Performances

evidence.what: DECISIVE, declared: transitionLink: HappensBefore[0..1]; connector guardConstraint: TPCGuardConstraint[*] from transitionLink to guard; and assoc struct TPCGuardConstraint { private inv { allTrue(constrainedGuard()) } }. A happens-before link exists only where every guard evaluates true, and a transition whose guard never can gets the multiplicity's lower bound of 0.

Declared: abstract action def TransitionAction :> Action, TransitionPerformance -- the base type of all TransitionUsages. This is the declared chain by which the KerML invariant governs a SysML state transition.
Declared: specializesFromLibrary('Actions::transitionActions'), closing the chain above; and the guardExpression, succession, source and target attributes exist as declared features.

evidence.source: SysML v2.0 formal/2026-03-02, clause 8.3.18.9 TransitionUsage, Description (identical text in SysML.xmi ownedComment)
evidence.what: CORROBORATING prose: 'When triggered by a triggerAction, when its guardExpression is true, the TransitionUsage asserts that its source is exited ... and then its target is entered.' Listed separately so the record does not present prose as declared structure.

oracleWhy: No reference implementation was executed. The Workbench takes no runtime dependency on the SysML v2 Pilot Implementation (DESIGN-v02-semantics-261004.md section 35.1), and this wave added none. source.sysml Part B has not been parsed by any tool.
reviewedByPersonWhy: Section 35.6's template field is spelled read_by: <person>, and no person has read this fixture. Recorded as null rather than filled with the wave's name.
bound: Covers the guard only. Does not exercise triggers, which MAGE has no analogue of -- its sync: events are a different mechanism. Does not exercise entry/do/exit actions, which MAGE states do not carry. Claims nothing about HappensBefore as time: MAGE analyses a finite configuration space with no clock, and the temporal semantics belong to DESIGN-v02-ltl-foundation-261004.md.
